In its current form, Cardano governance and voting on treasury withdrawals have revealed significant dysfunctionalities.
In particular, treasury withdrawal actions from different, but likewise important domains have led to a perceived competition for scarce resources.
This opened the door to hostility and detrimental conflict within the community and has invited toxicity.
There now is ill will and strife that harm the Cardano ecosystem, endangering its existence.
